name: Necron Warrior Phalanx

loreStats.armorComposition: Living Metal (Necrodermis) Phase-Alloy Matrix with Autonomous Nanite Lattice
loreStats.citation: Codex: Necrons (9th Ed), Nate Crowley - The Twice-Dead King: Ruin (2021)
loreStats.loreSummary: Ancient soulless mechanical foot-soldiers clad in self-repairing living metal necrodermis. They advance in eerie synchronized silence, disintegrating organic and armored foes atom by atom while passively reforming battlefield damage.

tacticalDescription: Unwavering frontline line infantry. High passive resilience and armor with reanimation survivability. Vulnerable to fast flanking assault due to slow traverse speed.
